title: The NIST Definition of Cloud Computing
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
excerpt: Defines essential cloud characteristics, service models, and deployment models used to distinguish cloud operating concerns from provider branding.

title: OCI Image Specification
excerpt: Defines content-addressable image manifests, configuration, layers, descriptors, platform metadata, and digest-based identity.

title: Docker Documentation: Multi-stage Builds
excerpt: Documents named build stages and selective artifact copying so build toolchains do not have to ship in runtime images.

title: Compose Specification
excerpt: Defines services, networks, volumes, configuration, secrets, dependencies, and lifecycle behavior for multi-container applications.

title: The Twelve-Factor App: Config
excerpt: Separates deploy-varying configuration from code and emphasizes environment-based configuration without committing credentials.

title: Kubernetes Documentation: Deployments
excerpt: Documents declarative Deployment updates, ReplicaSets, rollout status, rolling strategies, revisions, rollback, scaling, and failure handling.

title: Kubernetes Documentation: Liveness, Readiness, and Startup Probes
excerpt: Distinguishes restart, traffic-readiness, and startup diagnostics and documents how kubelet reacts to each result.

title: Kubernetes Documentation: Secrets
excerpt: Documents Secret objects, delivery to workloads, access controls, encryption considerations, and security cautions around sensitive configuration.

title: Kubernetes Documentation: DNS for Services and Pods
excerpt: Defines cluster DNS records and naming behavior for Services and Pods used to trace workload network paths.

title: Terraform CLI Documentation: Plan
excerpt: Documents speculative and saved execution plans, refresh behavior, proposed changes, automation use, and plan-file sensitivity.

title: OpenTelemetry Documentation: Signals
excerpt: Defines traces, metrics, logs, baggage, and profiles as complementary telemetry signals for observing distributed workloads.

title: Google SRE Book: Service Level Objectives
excerpt: Defines SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, user-centered measurements, percentile reasoning, and error budgets for operating decisions.

title: Google SRE Book: Managing Incidents
excerpt: Explains incident command, operational roles, communication, control, recovery, and structured learning from production failures.

title: DORA: A History of the Four Keys
excerpt: Defines deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and failed deployment recovery time as software-delivery performance measures.

title: SLSA Specification
excerpt: Defines supply-chain threat models, build provenance, verification, and assurance tracks for producing and consuming software artifacts.

title: Secure Software Development Framework
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
excerpt: Defines secure development practices across preparation, software protection, secure production, and vulnerability response.

title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0
excerpt: Defines version precedence and major, minor, patch, prerelease, and build metadata semantics for public interfaces.

title: FinOps Framework
excerpt: Defines principles, personas, capabilities, and iterative practices for understanding and optimizing cloud value and usage.
